scripts.test:execute: pnpm run prepare:deps && mkdir -p target && cucumber-js --config cucumber.cjs
scripts.test:report: pnpm run report:setup && serenity-bdd run --features features --output target/site/serenity
scripts.test:step-insight:contract: pnpm run prepare:deps && pnpm exec ts-node-esm ./scripts/check-step-insight-contract.ts
scripts.test:backend-mode:contract: pnpm run prepare:deps && pnpm exec ts-node-esm ./scripts/check-backend-mode-contract.ts
scripts.test:standalone-timing:contract: pnpm run prepare:deps && pnpm exec ts-node-esm ./scripts/check-standalone-timing-contract.ts
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:step-insight:contract && pnpm run test:backend-mode:contract && pnpm run test:standalone-timing:contract && pnpm run test:all
scripts.test:batch-sweep:contract: pnpm run prepare:deps && pnpm exec ts-node-esm ./scripts/check-batch-sweep-contract.ts
scripts.batch-sweep:run: pnpm run prepare:deps && pnpm exec ts-node-esm ./scripts/run-batch-sweep.ts
scripts.test:batch-sweep: pnpm run test:batch-sweep:contract && pnpm run batch-sweep:run
